name: purify-edge
tagline: DOMPurify without jsdom: identical output, 4x faster, runs on Cloudflare Workers
summary: purify-edge runs the unmodified DOMPurify on a small parse5-based DOM instead of jsdom. Output is byte-identical to DOMPurify on jsdom, it is about 65 KB gzipped, and it runs on Cloudflare Workers and other edge runtimes where jsdom cannot. Migrating from isomorphic-dompurify is a one-line import change.

features: The sanitizer is DOMPurify 3.4.16, pinned and unpatched, so every allow list, hook and config option carries over
Passes DOMPurify's own official suite (984 tests, 1,247 assertions) with results identical to the jsdom run
Runs in workerd (Cloudflare Workers) without the Node compatibility flag, in the Vercel edge isolate, and on Node 20 to 24
Bundle is 218.5 KB minified, 65.6 KB gzipped, with parse5, DOMPurify and the DOM shim included
Drop-in for isomorphic-dompurify: change one import line
how_it_works: About 800 lines of commented JavaScript implement the window and DOM that DOMPurify calls, with HTML parsing and serialization done by parse5.
DOMPurify runs on that window exactly as it would on jsdom, so the sanitizing rules are DOMPurify's own.
Parity with DOMPurify on jsdom is checked by the official suite, a differential fuzzer and parity corpora, all run in CI.

The first metric uses the 223-vector parity table; the official-suite and fuzz facts are in features: 'DOMPurify's own official test suite, unmodified, run on the shim window: 984 tests, 1,247 assertions, identical to the jsdom run assertion by assertion, 0 failures.' and '200,000 inputs, 800,000 comparisons, 0 differences' on the four default configs. Speed and memory numbers are from README tables (Apple M5 Max, Node 24.20.0, median of 5, DOMPurify 3.4.16 vs isomorphic-dompurify 4.4.0); not re-run here. Memory figures 1,236 MB to 307 MB come from the README table row for corpus c (peak RSS c). Bundle size from results/edge-size.json: esmMin 218774 bytes, esmGzip 65647 bytes.
